column1: # Which payload attribute names a step: priority<TAB>type_match<TAB>attr_name
# Example rules, matching source-catalogue.example.txt. Read at startup, upserted into ocel.discriminator_rule. Lowest priority wins when two rules match. type_match is a
# LIKE pattern against the event type; '%' is a rule for every type.
# Without these, two decisions by two different roles are one activity: every multi-stage approval reads as 100 %
# rework and the variant list collapses.
